title: Restricted resolution sections data
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], an O_X-module F [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], an injective resolution I of F, and an open U of X, RestrictedResolutionSections(I,U) consists of an injective resolution of F restricted to U, an augmentation-preserving isomorphism from that restricted resolution to I restricted to U, and an induced isomorphism between its global-sections complex and the section complex of I over U, with the displayed comparison components given by restriction and the resolution isomorphism.
